The '''Treasure Trail Statistics''' is an object which players can look at to check the amount of [[Treasure Trails]] they have completed. It shows the [[scroll box]] capacity of each tier, progress until the next scroll case of that tier, and if the [[Mimic scroll case]] has been obtained.

==Ranks==
[[File:Treasure Trail Statistics interface.png|thumb|Example interface for an avid clue solver.]]
The interface also shows the player's [[Treasure_Trails#Ranks|Treasure Trails rank]]. This rank is determined by the total amount of completed [[clue scroll]]s.

==Locations==
*In the observatory reception house, located just north of the [[Observatory]].
*In [[Watson's house]].
